exchanges.title: 1. Exchanges
exchanges.p1: Clothing, footwear, and accessories may be exchanged within 14 calendar days from the purchase date or the date the order is received, except for the non-returnable items listed below.
exchanges.p2: An exchange is available only if the item has not been worn, washed, damaged, or altered, shows no signs of use, stains, or odors, and all original tags and labels remain attached.
exchanges.p3: Size or color exchanges are subject to availability. If the requested option is unavailable, an alternative item or a return may be offered.
exchanges.p4: A receipt, electronic invoice, or order confirmation is required.

returns.title: 2. Returns
returns.p1: Returns are accepted within 14 days of receiving the order only at a Mamaria store and with the cash-register receipt. Otherwise, no return is accepted.
returns.p2: If Mamaria delivers an incorrect, defective, or damaged item, the customer may return it or exchange it for the correct item without an additional delivery charge.
returns.p3: After the returned item is received, Mamaria will inspect its condition and notify the customer whether the return has been approved or declined.

refunds.title: 3. Refunds
refunds.p1: For an approved return, the refund will be issued to the original payment method or another method agreed by the parties.
refunds.p2: Card refunds are processed within up to 7 business days. The final posting time may vary depending on the bank.
refunds.p3: Delivery fees are non-refundable unless the delivered item was incorrect, defective, or damaged.

cancellation.title: 4. Order Cancellation
cancellation.p1: An order may be canceled before it is handed over to the delivery service.
cancellation.p2: Once the order has been shipped, it cannot be canceled, but it may be returned after delivery under this policy.

personalized.title: 5. Personalized Orders
personalized.p1: Items made with a name, initials, embroidery, custom sizing, or another personalized modification cannot be returned or exchanged unless they are defective or were produced incorrectly.

items.underwear: Underwear and bodysuits if the hygienic or factory packaging has been opened or the item has been tried on.
items.socks: Socks and tights if the packaging has been opened.
items.swimwear: Swimwear if the hygienic protective seal has been removed.
items.other: Other items whose return is restricted by applicable law for hygiene or safety reasons.

specialNote.title: Special note
specialNote.p1: If an item is damaged, incorrect, or affected during delivery, please contact Mamaria as soon as possible and keep the original packaging.
specialNote.p2: This policy does not limit any mandatory consumer rights provided by applicable law.
